name: Agent Reach Internet Search
description: Searches and reads the platforms AnythingLLM's built-in browsing cannot reach: Bilibili, YouTube transcripts, V2EX, GitHub, Reddit, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Xiaohongshu, Xueqiu stocks, Boss jobs, Xiaoyuzhou podcasts, Facebook, Instagram. Runs the local agent-reach CLI. Use when the user asks to search or read those platforms.
author: BMI AI Assistant

input.hint: Binary name or absolute path of the agent-reach CLI on the server running AnythingLLM.

examples.prompt: Search Bilibili for videos about LLMs

channel.description: Platform channel: bilibili, v2ex, github, youtube, web, xiaohongshu, xueqiu, boss, xiaoyuzhou, linkedin, reddit, twitter, facebook, instagram, or read (fetch any URL via auto channel routing).

action.description: Channel action, e.g. search, hot, video, user, repo, issue, thread, quote, jobs. Run with empty action to list what the channel supports.

query.description: Search keywords, ID, or topic for the channel action.

url.description: Full URL to read when channel is read (auto-selects the right channel).
